description: Search for Zendesk organizations using autocomplete. Use when you need to find organization suggestions based on a partial organization name for ticket creation, user assignment, or organization lookup. The `name` parameter is required - provide at least a few characters for meaningful autocomplete results. Returns organizations sorted by relevance.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk organizations with autocomplete.

field_id.description: The ID of a lookup relationship field. The type of field is determined by the `source` parameter. Use this to filter results based on custom field values.
field_id.title: Field Id

name.description: A substring of an organization name to search for. The API returns organizations whose name starts with or contains this substring. Case-insensitive matching is applied.
name.title: Name

source.description: If a `field_id` is provided, this specifies the type of the field. For example, if the field is on a 'zen:user', it references a field on a user.
source.title: Source

inputSchema.title: GetOrganizationsAutocompleteRequest

name: get_organizations_autocomplete

next_page.description: URL to the next page of results (if pagination is available)
next_page.title: Next Page

organizations.description: An array of organizations matching the search query. Returns organizations whose name starts with or contains the search substring.
organizations.title: Organizations

previous_page.description: URL to the previous page of results (if pagination is available)
previous_page.title: Previous Page

ZendeskOrganization.description: Zendesk organization object returned by autocomplete.

domain_names.description: Domain names associated with the organization
domain_names.title: Domain Names

external_id.description: Case-insensitive external identifier for linking to external records
external_id.title: External Id

group_id.description: Group ID for automatic ticket routing
group_id.title: Group Id

organization_fields.description: Custom field values for the organization
organization_fields.title: Organization Fields

shared_comments.description: Whether end users can comment on each other's tickets
shared_comments.title: Shared Comments

shared_tickets.description: Whether end users can view each other's tickets
shared_tickets.title: Shared Tickets

url.description: API endpoint URL for this organization
url.title: Url

ZendeskOrganization.title: ZendeskOrganization
